rule.pl: Kazda istotna zmiana, test, awaria, rollback, nowy modul, nowa czesc i decyzja projektowa trafia na WWW. Pamiec czatu nie jest zrodlem prawdy.
rule.en: Every significant change, test, failure, rollback, new module, new part and project decision is documented on the web. Chat memory is not the source of truth.

mandatory_www_targets.name: Public Source of Truth
mandatory_www_targets.role: Durable public history and project state

mandatory_www_targets.name: Kora Master Panel
mandatory_www_targets.role: Primary Pi-side project state, modules and changelog

mandatory_www_targets.name: Kora Live
mandatory_www_targets.role: Live runtime view; must also expose a concise current-work summary

mandatory_www_targets.name: Kora Live JSON
mandatory_www_targets.role: Machine-readable live runtime; must also expose a concise documentation/current-work field

documentation_sync_rule.pl: Po kazdej istotnej pracy publiczny Source of Truth, Master Panel, Live i Live JSON musza zostac zaktualizowane. Na WWW trafia opis i status, bez wklejania kodu.
documentation_sync_rule.en: After every significant work item, update the public Source of Truth, Master Panel, Live and Live JSON. Publish summaries and status on the web, not source code.

status_policy.WORKING: Only after a successful real functional/voice test.
status_policy.CODE_OK: Code compiles or passes static checks, but real test is still pending.
status_policy.TESTING: Installed or prepared and currently under real-world testing.
status_policy.FAILED: Real test failed or caused a regression.
status_policy.ROLLED_BACK: The failed change was reverted to the previous known state.

current_priority.title: Stabilise the head, then test foot contact and LiDAR reactions
current_priority.details_pl: Chodzenie Kory jest potwierdzone i opublikowane. Glowa, ruchome oczy i rozowe futerko sa juz zamontowane. Jedno serwo glowy wyraznie skrzeczy i ma zostac wymienione. Nastepne testy obejmuja switche w stopach oraz reakcje ruchowe wykorzystujace dzialajacy LiDAR; integracja nastroju z mowa ciala pozostaje kolejnym celem.
current_priority.details_en: Kora's walking is confirmed and published. The head, moving eyes and pink fur are now installed. One head servo audibly squeaks and is marked for replacement. The next tests cover foot switches and movement reactions using the working LiDAR; mood-driven body language remains the next behaviour layer.

recent_content_work.summary_pl: Opublikowano dwa kolejne etapy Kory: pierwszy film potwierdza chodzenie i skrecanie szesciodroznego korpusu bez glowy, a drugi pokazuje zamontowana glowe, ruchome oczy i dodatkowe rozowe futerko. Jedno serwo glowy skrzeczy i jest przeznaczone do wymiany.
recent_content_work.summary_en: Two new Kora milestones are published: the first video confirms walking and turning with the six-legged body before the head was installed; the second shows the installed head, moving eyes and additional pink fur. One head servo squeaks and is marked for replacement.

active_issues.summary: One head servo audibly squeaks during operation and is marked for replacement before treating the head mechanism as fully healthy.
Foot switches are the next gait-sensing test so each leg can confirm ground contact before more advanced terrain behaviour.
LiDAR is working; the next stage is linking obstacle/environment readings to deliberate movement reactions.
Walking is confirmed. Current work maps Kora's mood to coordinated whole-body and leg movement so posture and motion reflect her emotional state.
Wake acknowledgement works, but the full reply after a spoken question still needs a confirmed end-to-end test.
English spontaneous answers can fall into laptop_ollama_en_lang_guard and repeat generic secretary-like wording.
English time questions must be handled locally and must not fall through to generic conversation/model routing.

safety.rule: STOP/release/PWM-off and core listening must take priority over personality, local dialogue and model routing.

next_test: Replace the noisy head servo and confirm quiet, repeatable head motion.
Run controlled foot-switch tests one leg at a time before using contact sensing in gait.
Link working LiDAR readings to a safe stop/turn/avoidance reaction.
Verify that the confirmed walking gait remains stable after mood-driven body motion is enabled.
Confirm a complete wake → spoken question → answer cycle in Polish and English.
Record confirmed results in the Master Panel, Live, Live JSON and this public Source of Truth.
